Title: GUID migration: Azure Security Center, US Government regions

Body.Content:
Starting June 1, 2018, billing will be reported on an hourly basis (per node per hour). With this change, you’ll receive greater granularity in billing.

Also, there will be a change to the resource GUIDs. There won’t be a pricing impact from this change, but you will need to modify billing routines that rely on resource GUIDs.
